text:
maya: Heads up — started gated promote for model v12-int4 via PhaseGate at 09:00 PT. Initial A/B (1% traffic) looks fine on latency/cost but we see a 3.7% drop in long-doc MRR on the docs_summarize slice.
cheng: Ack. Can you paste the slice breakdown? is that absolute MRR or relative?
maya: relative vs v11-fp16 baseline. Short answers + rerank slices are flat, long-doc (>=3k tokens) is the only one with signal. Sample sizes: n=1.2k for long-doc at 1% traffic.
alex: 1% is noisy, but 3.7% is notable. Do we have per-token align / prefix mismatch stats?
maya: quick query I ran:
```
SELECT slice, metric_name, pct_change
FROM canary_eval
WHERE model = 'v12-int4' AND baseline='v11-fp16' AND slice IN ('long_docs','summary_trunc','rerank_short')
```
Results: long_docs MRR -3.7%, prefix-mismatch +0.9%, avg latency +12ms p50 (still under SLO).
samir: Could be quantization edge-case for very long KV workloads. Did you warm KV cache for these flows?
maya: yes, warmed. Batching profile shows more frequent small batches for long-docs which might expose ADAM/attention kernel path differences.
lisa: Any drift in input distribution? OOD prompts?
maya: Not obvious — prompt length distribution matches production. But there is heavier HTML encoding in that slice (we strip minimal markup). Might interact with tokenization differences in int4 path.
cheng: Okay let's hold the ramp. Manual fallback threshold is 2% MRR drop for any safety-important slice. We're at 3.7% so abort promotion, switch traffic back to v11 fully.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Rolling back traffic to v11-fp16 per request from eng-ml. Initiating automated fallback.
deploy-bot: rollback started: rollback_id=rb_2026_1738880000 user=maya
maya: Thanks. Next steps I propose: 1) run shadow-on long_docs with int4 for 100k requests to get higher n; 2) produce token-level divergence heatmap; 3) run targeted unit tests for attention/kernels with extremely long sequences.
alex: +1. Also add a diffed sample of model outputs (50 worst regressions) for qualitative inspection — hallucination/omission patterns.
samir: I'll spin a GPU job to run 200k shadow calls with KV warmup and same batching semantics we saw in-prod. ETA ~3h.
lisa: I'll pull tokenizer tokenization diffs for the sample set and check for subtle truncation or encoding mismatches.
maya: I'll create a PhaseGate incident note and update telemetry with a new flag so we can auto-fail if long_doc MRR drop >2% at promotion time. Suggested gate config change: add weighted-slice thresholds where long_docs weight=2x.
cheng: Good call. We should also add automatic cooldown: if a weighted-slice breach occurs, reduce ramp to 0% immediately and send pagers only if breach persists >15min.
maya: Draft config snippet (PhaseGate config):
```
{
  "slices": {
    "long_docs": { "weight": 2, "max_regress_pct": 2.0 },
    "summary_trunc": { "weight": 1, "max_regress_pct": 4.0 }
  },
  "cooldown_minutes": 15,
  "auto_fallback": true
}
```
cheng: Minor nit — make sure weights are normalized in the scoring math, otherwise promotion math will be weird. Also document that max_regress_pct is relative to baseline.
alex: When we re-run, we should also try a hybrid run: int4 but with fp16 KV cache enabled (if runtime supports). Could isolate whether kv-path quant affects long-context.
samir: I'll include that flag in the shadow job.
maya: I'll open a PR for PhaseGate config + a runbook update (rollback steps + telemetry links). Assigning to @cheng for config review and @lisa for tokenization check.
lisa: assigned, will start in 30m.
cheng: assigned, will review PR before EOD.
maya: Thanks team. Quick reminder: since latency/cost looked good, this is a quality-first hold — we don't want to trade user trust for 5-10% infra savings. :white_check_mark:
alex: Agreed. Ping if you want me to do the qualitative readout.
ops-bot: incident created: PG-1738880000 "phasegate long-doc regression" severity=medium links=[/incidents/PG-1738880000]
maya: I'll post a summary in #product after we have the diffed outputs. For now, holding promote and collecting data.
cheng: closing loop — manual fallback successful, telemetry captured. We'll reconvene once shadow run results are in. :thumbsup:
